Upload supporting documents separately against each claim (date of birth, category, qualification, experience, etc.) as individual PDFs – do not upload pay slips, resumes, appointment/relieving letters, or unsigned experience certificates in this module.

content_sections.heading: UPSC Advt 12/2026 Eligibility (Post-wise)
content_sections.text: Degree in Science or Engineering from a recognized University/Institute, with Associateship in Sugar Technology OR Post-graduate Diploma in Sugar Technology Experience: 3 years' teaching/research/advisory experience in Sugar Technology, OR 3 years' practical experience in a sugar factory in a managerial capacity Desirable: M.Sc. (Chemistry) or M.Tech (Sugar Technology); experience in drafting/editing scientific and technological reports A Degree in Law from a recognized University or equivalent, AND one of: 7+ years as a member of a State Judicial Service; OR 7+ years in a superior post in a State's legal department; OR 7+ years as a Central Government servant with legal-affairs experience; OR a Master's Degree in Law with 5+ years of teaching/research experience in Law; OR a qualified legal practitioner of at least 30 years of age (7+ years as advocate/pleader, or 5+ years as a High Court attorney in Bombay/Calcutta, or a combined 5+ years as attorney and advocate). Desirable: experience in legislative drafting (preference given if the post is in the Legislative Department). Degree in Law from a recognized Institute/University 2 years' experience in legal work as a Legal Practitioner, OR 2 years' legal-work experience in a Government office A recognized medical qualification under the Indian Medical Council Act, 1956 (First/Second Schedule or Part-II of Third Schedule, other than a licentiate qualification) Post-graduate degree in Cardiology (D.M. Cardiology) or equivalent 3 years' experience in Cardiology after obtaining the post-graduate degree Note: All qualifications are relaxable at UPSC's discretion, for reasons recorded in writing, for candidates who are otherwise well qualified.

content_sections.heading: UPSC Advt 12/2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Where applications are numerous, UPSC may apply shortlisting criteria: higher desirable qualifications, higher-than-minimum educational qualification, higher-than-minimum relevant experience, experience before/after acquiring essential qualification, experience not otherwise prescribed, or a Recruitment Test Minimum level of suitability at interview (out of 100 marks): UR–50, OBC–45, SC/ST/PH–40 Where an RT precedes the interview, candidates must clear the minimum suitability level at both stages; the RT qualifying level is decided case-by-case by UPSC Where an RT/CRT is held, it will ordinarily be conducted at: Ahmedabad, Bhopal, Chennai, Delhi, Dispur (Guwahati), Jaipur, Jammu, Kochi, Kolkata, Lucknow, Mumbai, Nagpur, Port Blair, Ranchi, and Visakhapatnam (Leh/Kargil/Srinagar/Delhi for Ladakh UT posts) Candidature is provisional at every stage; mere fulfilment of minimum qualification/experience does not guarantee a call for interview Where sufficient eligible PwBD candidates are not available for exclusively-reserved posts, the experience requirement (years, not nature) may be relaxed up to 50%

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for UPSC Advt 12/2026
content_sections.text: Visit upsconline.nic.in and create an account, if not already registered. Complete Universal Registration (generates a Universal Registration Number, or URN, common across all UPSC recruitments) and the Common Application Form (CAF). Fill the post/vacancy-specific fourth module for the post you are applying to; this generates a post-specific Application Number. Upload your photograph and capture a live photo as part of the CAF; sign three times on plain white paper in black ink and upload the signature. Upload supporting documents separately against each claim (date of birth, category, qualification, experience, etc.) as individual PDFs – do not upload pay slips, resumes, appointment/relieving letters, or unsigned experience certificates in this module. Pay the application fee of ₹25 online (Visa/Master/RuPay Card, UPI, or net banking), if applicable to your category. Review all entries carefully – no correction, alteration, or withdrawal is allowed after final submission. Submit before the closing date: 16 October 2026, 1800 hrs. Take a printout of the finally submitted application; you are not required to send this to UPSC by post, but must bring it (with original documents) if called for interview. Important: Fee once paid is non-refundable and cannot be held in reserve for another exam/selection. Applications without the prescribed fee will be summarily rejected.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Matriculation/10th standard certificate or mark sheet showing date of birth Degree/Diploma certificate as proof of educational qualification (or provisional certificate plus all mark sheets, if the final certificate is not yet issued) Order/letter proving equivalence, if claiming a qualification as "equivalent" to the one prescribed Experience certificate(s) in the prescribed proforma from the Head of Organisation/Department, clearly stating dates, pay, and nature of duties (part-time/daily-wage/guest-faculty experience is not counted) Caste certificate (SC/ST/OBC) in the prescribed proforma from a competent authority; OBC candidates must also submit a non-creamy-layer declaration as on the closing date Disability certificate in the prescribed proforma from a duly constituted Medical Board, for PwBD candidates Certificate/document for age relaxation (Ex-servicemen, Central/UT Government employees, or special provisions), as applicable Declaration by candidates already in regular Government service, confirming they have informed their Head of Office/Department of this application Name-change documents (marriage/remarriage/divorce or other), if applicable Certified translation (by a Gazetted Officer or notary) for any document not in Hindi or English

content_sections.heading: Important Conditions
content_sections.text: Citizenship: Indian citizen, or a subject of Nepal/Bhutan, or a Tibetan refugee (pre-1962), or a person of Indian origin migrated from certain specified countries with an eligibility certificate from the Government of India A candidate applying under UR cannot later claim a reserved category; requests to switch between reserved categories are not entertained; PwBD candidates cannot change their disability sub-category Reserved-category candidates who fail to substantiate their claim by the prescribed stage will be considered against unreserved vacancies if they otherwise meet UR conditions Mobile phones, smart watches, pen drives, cameras, Bluetooth devices, etc. are strictly banned in the examination/interview hall Face authentication and identity verification are mandatory at the examination venue/interview hall Scribe facility is available for specified PwBD categories (blindness, both-arms-affected locomotor disability, cerebral palsy automatically; others on production of a medical certificate) Furnishing false particulars, impersonation, using unfair means, or misconduct can lead to disqualification, debarment (permanent or for a specified period) from UPSC exams and Central Government employment, and disciplinary/criminal action Canvassing in any form will disqualify a candidate Outstation candidates called for interview at UPSC are reimbursed travel expenses restricted to Second/Sleeper Class train fare, paid via NEFT/bank transfer Summoning for interview does not guarantee selection; UPSC may recommend higher initial pay for meritorious candidates For the Law Officer post, GNCTD's own OBC reservation rules apply (a valid GNCTD-recognized OBC certificate, or one traceable to a GNCTD-issued family certificate for those settled in Delhi before 8 September 1993, is required)

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) for various positions under Advertisement Number 12/2026 across different specialized fields.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in UPSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 13 vacancies have been announced under this notification, covering posts like Junior Technical Officer, Assistant Legislative Counsel, Law Officer, and Specialist Grade II.

faq.question: Q3. What are the start and end dates for online applications?
faq.answer: The online application process begins on 26 September 2026 and concludes on 16 October 2026. Candidates must submit their forms within this timeframe.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required qualification for Assistant Legislative Counsel?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Assistant Legislative Counsel post must possess a Degree in Law from a recognized university along with relevant legal experience as specified.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for female and SC/ST candidates?
faq.answer: Female, SC, ST, and PwBD candidates are completely exempted from paying any application fee, meaning they can apply for free (Rs. 0).

faq.question: Q6. What is the maximum age limit for the Law Officer post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Law Officer position is 30 years, with admissible age relaxations provided for OBC and other eligible categories.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process typically includes a Recruitment Test or Combined Recruitment Test, shortlisting based on qualifications and experience, followed by an interview and document verification.

faq.question: Q8. Can candidates apply offline for these vacancies?
faq.answer: No, applications must be submitted exclusively in online mode through the official UPSC online portal at https://upsconline.nic.in before the closing date.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary scale for Specialist Grade II (Cardiology)?
faq.answer: The Specialist Grade II (Junior Scale) in Cardiology is entitled to Level-11 plus Non-Practicing Allowance (NPA) in the Pay Matrix as per the 7th CPC.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification link?
faq.answer: You can access the official notification PDF and application portal directly through the Important Links section provided within this recruitment article.
